result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the bottom tab bar is broken: the iOS home-indicator bar is drawn directly on top of the navigation icons because the bar has no bottom safe-area padding, and the tab items have no text labels. Carousel clipping at the right edge and the card cut off at the viewport bottom were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar does not respect the device safe-area inset: the black iOS home-indicator pill overlaps and visually strikes through the Search and Orders tab icons, making them look crossed out and partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding (e.g. env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) to the tab bar container and increase its height so icons sit above the home indicator, keeping the indicator in its own empty strip.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar items are icon-only with no visible labels, so the meaning of the bookmark/receipt and person icons is ambiguous and the active state is conveyed by color alone.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each tab icon (Home, Search, Orders, Account) and ensure each has an accessible name plus a non-color active indicator.
